description: This file is a configuration include script for building a cross-compiled version of GDB using the OpenEmbedded build system. It specifies dependencies, configuration options, and custom build steps for the 'gdb-cross-canadian' target, including package configuration and environment setup.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Prepares a custom Python script within the build directory to configure Python environment variables for cross-compilation.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Removes certain directories and sets up bindir links to prevent GDB from providing certain binary file format components overridden by binutils.
